opening_hours.notes: Check for seasonal exhibitions and events.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about the castle's fascinating history.

places.name: Turku Cathedral
places.ai_summary: A magnificent cathedral with stunning architecture, serving as a symbol of Finnish Christianity and history.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special events and services.

places.place_tip: Admire the intricate wooden carvings and stained glass windows.

places.name: Aboa Vetus & Ars Nova Museum
places.ai_summary: A unique museum combining contemporary art and archaeological history, located in the heart of Turku.

opening_hours.notes: Check for temporary exhibitions and events.

places.place_tip: Explore the underground ruins for a glimpse into medieval Turku.
places.address: Aboa Vetus & Ars Nova, Turku, Finland

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about the art collections.
